---
name: New vertical pack
about: Propose a pack for a new trade or clinic type (data only, no code)
labels: enhancement, good first issue, needs-triage
---

**Vertical** (for example: dental, physio, driving instructors, pet grooming)

**Typical services** (the exact service names a business would use on its calendar)

**Sensible reminder offsets** (for example 48h / 24h / 2h, and why)

**Offer expiry** (how long a freed slot offer should stay live for this trade, and why)

**Template wording notes** (tone, formality, anything this trade says differently; include draft templates if you have them)

**Are you happy to draft the YAML pack yourself?** (yes / no, either is fine)
